lessons.title: Reading: My Weekend Plans
lessons.titleNative: O'qish: mening dam olish kunlarim rejasi
lessons.context: A short passage about weekend plans and hobbies.

paragraphs.uz: Har hafta oxirida men turli mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanaman.
paragraphs.en: Every weekend I engage in various activities.

paragraphs.uz: Shanba kuni odatda sport zaliga boraman.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday I usually go to the gym.
After exercising I meet with my friends.
We go to a café together and chat.

paragraphs.uz: Yakshanba kuni esa oilam bilan vaqt o'tkazaman.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday, however, I spend time with my family.
Sometimes we go out into nature and take a walk.

paragraphs.uz: Bu mening haftalik yuklamamdan dam olishning eng yaxshi usuli.
paragraphs.en: This is the best way for me to rest from my weekly workload.

questions.question: U shanba kuni odatda qayerga boradi?
Yakshanba kuni u kim bilan vaqt o'tkazadi?
